title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Cameroon? Complete Price Guide 2026
author: Slim Biz
excerpt: How much does a website cost in Cameroon in 2026? From simple landing pages to full e-commerce platforms, here is the complete breakdown of website design and development prices in Cameroon.
body:
One of the most common questions we receive at Slim Biz is: how much does a website cost in Cameroon? The answer depends on several factors — the type of website, the number of pages, the features required, and the agency or developer you hire.

This guide gives you a clear, honest breakdown of website costs in Cameroon so you can budget properly and make the right decision for your business.

Types of Websites and Their Costs in Cameroon

Landing Page (1-3 pages): A simple landing page presenting your business, your services, and your contact information. This is the minimum any business needs. Cost range: 150,000 to 400,000 FCFA.

Business Website (5-10 pages): A complete website with Home, About, Services, Blog, and Contact pages. Includes a professional design, mobile optimization, and basic SEO. Cost range: 400,000 to 1,200,000 FCFA.

E-commerce Website: An online store where customers can browse products and place orders. Includes product pages, shopping cart, payment integration, and inventory management. Cost range: 800,000 to 3,000,000 FCFA depending on complexity.

Custom Web Application: A fully custom-built platform — a booking system, membership portal, or industry-specific tool. Cost range: 2,000,000 FCFA and above.

What Affects Website Pricing in Cameroon

Design complexity: A custom-designed website costs more than one built on a template. Custom designs are unique to your brand and tend to perform better.

Number of pages and features: More pages, more content, and more features (contact forms, booking systems, live chat, multilingual support) all add to the cost.

Content creation: If you need the agency to write the text and take or source photos, this adds to the total. Providing your own content reduces cost.

Ongoing maintenance: Websites need regular updates, security patches, and backups. Many agencies offer monthly maintenance packages ranging from 20,000 to 100,000 FCFA per month.

Domain and Hosting Costs

Separate from the design cost, you need a domain name and web hosting. A .com domain costs approximately 10,000 to 15,000 FCFA per year. Web hosting costs 30,000 to 150,000 FCFA per year depending on performance and storage.

Some agencies include the first year of hosting in their package. Always ask.

What to Look for When Hiring a Web Design Agency in Cameroon

Do not choose based on price alone. A cheap website that does not attract customers or rank on Google is worthless. Look for an agency with a strong portfolio, client testimonials, and a clear understanding of your business goals.

Also ask about: mobile responsiveness (your website must work perfectly on smartphones), page loading speed, SEO optimization from the start, and post-launch support.
